title: Midyat history
source_text:
Mәḏyaḏ meqәm, u+mede dmaḥkánwolan, kulayna suryóyewan harke ġắlăbe, kə́twolan suryoye ġắlăbe. 
Kə́twolan suryoye ġắlăbe harke‿mmiwo, yaʕni, kulle suryóyewәn, bas kәtwo mede ʕәṣri+ʕaylā̀t ṭaye d Mәḏyaḏ. 
D Mәḏyaḏ, harke, ʕәṣri, әmmíwolan kәtwo hawxa.
 Ŭ dáyima әmmiwo Mәḏyaḏ ġắlăbe basə́mtowa, Mәḏyaḏ. 
Mәḏyaḏ ʕatə́qtoyo, dukṯo ʕatə́qtoyo ġắlăbe, yaʕni dukṯe di+mšiḥùṯoyo. 
Kәtlan ʕitawoṯo, dayre harke ġắlăbe.
Ŭ ʕūdiwo, ʕūdiwo bann+arʕoṯo, ʕūdiwo, kə́twolәn săwā́l bu+waxtawo. 
Ínaqqa d̥kәtwayne aq+qamoye, kə́twolәn săwā́l, kə́twolәn arʕoṯo, u+ḥa d̥kə́twole săwā́l, әzzewo qmu+săwalayḏe, u+ḥa d̥kə́twole arʕoṯo, dowarwo ḥeṭe, sʕore, ṭlawḥe, kušne.
Hawxa maftiwo aḥ+ḥayyaṯṯe. 
Mukliwo an+naʕimaṯṯe bu+šәklano, muklíwolәn. 
Ġēr mede u+ḥa d̥kәtwe ṣәnʕatkā́r, yaʕni, ṣәnʕatkā́r d̥kәtwe, háwostene ʕәwadwo bi+ṣәnʕayḏe, d̥kәtwe tarzí,  d̥kәtwe zifkā́r,  d̥kәtwe... ṣópači kәmmínale, d̥kәtwe daʕ+ʕarše, sayomo daʕ+ʕarše, d̥kәtwe ḥaloqo, d̥kәtwe naǧoro, naǧoro dәksoyәm tarʕe, šbebәk. 
Ŭ hani kulle hawxa, kul+ḥa bi+ṣәnʕayḏe, mafәtwo aḥ+ḥayyayḏe harke. 
Ŭ bu+šәklano mrabanwo an+naʕimaṯṯe kulle.
 Bәṯr edi … hool lann+әštiyat…  bәṯr mann+әštiyat nafiqo Awrupa. 
Nafiqo Awrupa, u+ʕamo azzeyo lu+ʕwodo. 
Hәn mnayye l Awrupa, ŭ hәn mәn‿stene azzənyo dәmmina lә Ṣṭambul. 
Bu+suryoyo kәmmale azzәnyo lalʕәl. 
Azzə́n lalʕәl, yaʕni lә Ṣṭambul laš+šәrak, ʕūdiwo baš+šәrak du+peṭrṑl, ʕūdiwo bab+baraže, ʕūdiwo ba+hno.
Akṯariye bәṯr hedi azzәnyo l Awrupa bann+әštiyat, ínaqqa dnafiqo, dәṭlәbla Awrupa ʕawode, azzәnyo l Awrupa, dʕūdi ŭ doṯәn dduʕri l Mәḏyaḏ. 
Naqqa+ḥreto d̥saymәnne bote naḏife, ŭ d̥saymәnne šuġlone, damṭanne әšmo d̥kallā́t laǧan an+naʕimaṯṯe.
 E, bu+šәklano mdawamla hul la+tmoniyat. 
Bәṯr ma+tmoni daʕәrwo l Mәḏyaḏ, mәḏyoye daʕәrwo, taqriban ʕ̥ṣar ʕaylā́t aṯәn l Mәḏyaḏ, daʕiri. 
Ŭ bdalle ftәḥanne šuġlone әšmo mnayye, ŭ bәṯr edi baš+šeṯ ŭ tmoni, ba+šwaʕ̥ ŭ tmoni, bat+tәšʕiyat hedi ḥariwi a+d̥koṯani, edi u+ʕamo azzeyo naqqa+ḥreto l Awrupa. 
Bu+šәk̇lano.
Ŭ uʕdo harke fayišina. 
Kiban dәmmina mo ŭ tleṯi+ʕaylā̀t suryoye bgawә‿d Mәḏyaḏ. 
Ǧġēr bu+ṭuro d̥kәtla, bu+ṭuroste, kәtlan baq+qәryawoṯayḏan tavda uʕdo kulayna, kibux dәmmat, hul tralfo, tralfo ŭ ḥammәšmo+nafšoṯo b̥ Ṭur ʕAbdīn, b̥ Ṭur ʕAbdīn, kәmmínala Ṭur ʕAbdīn, bu+ṭuro, háwxayo.
